scripts.text: A great stone gate stands before you. The sculpture of a terrible dragon spreads its powerful looking wings.
Near the bottom of the gate, Laphine tribeswomen have been turned to stone and now look like they are part of the great door.
Move closer to look more carefully.
Step back.
A mysterious power prevents you from getting too close. It looks like there is something strong beyond the door...
Perhaps there's a great hidden secret beyond the gate, beyond expectation.
It would be better to go back to camp and inform the others and ask for help.
You'll have to obtain the others trust in the expendition camp by working hard.

Perhaps there's a great hidden secret beyond the gate, beyond expectation.
It would be better to go back to camp and inform the others and ask for help.
You'll have to obtain the others trust in the expendition camp by working hard.
The strange sensation surrounding your body has disappeared
When you touch the stone gate, you hear a commanding voice.
Wingless one... Our promised words...
'Guardian's spell'!
Take a step back.
Promised words... Guardian's spell... proof of their existence.

scripts.speaker: Yggdrasil Gatekeeper
scripts.text: In the name of Yggdrasiliad, I will accept you as a servant of the Guardian.

scripts.speaker: Yggdrasil Gatekeeper
scripts.text: I accept your entrance through the Guardian's gate. You are now considered a faithful servant of the Guardian Nidhoggur.
The voice has disappeared, and the dark power is calming down from behind the stone gate.
As I put my hands on the stone gate, a voice sounded from the depth of my heart.

scripts.speaker: Yggdrasil Gatekeeper
scripts.text: Where are the other servants, so you can work together? Each servant cannot be admitted here individually...

scripts.speaker: Yggdrasil Gatekeeper
scripts.text: Come with at least 1 more servant... Only party leaders can accept admission to Nidhoggur's Nest.

scripts.speaker: Yggdrasil Gatekeeper
scripts.text: And only 1 representative of you needs to talk to me, so don't annoy me...

scripts.speaker: Yggdrasil Gatekeeper
scripts.text: The loyal servants of the Guardian... what can I do for you?
Please allow me to enter.
I want to go in.
I want to leave.

scripts.speaker: Yggdrasil Gatekeeper
scripts.text: The Guardian seems to wish to be alone. I will go in and check, please wait out here.

scripts.speaker: Yggdrasil Gatekeeper
scripts.text: I've recorded your request, are you ready to go inside?

scripts.speaker: Yggdrasil Gatekeeper
scripts.text: If you are ready, I will allow you to enter.

scripts.speaker: Yggdrasil Gatekeeper
scripts.text: If you have the dungeon generated already, you can enter it.
I want to go in.
I want to leave.

scripts.speaker: Yggdrasil Gatekeeper
scripts.text: With the defeat of Nidhoggur's Shadow, the roots of the World Tree Yggdrasil are also affected.

scripts.speaker: Yggdrasil Gatekeeper
scripts.text: After Nidhoggur's Shadow disappears, at least 3 days is needed for stabilizing.

scripts.speaker: Yggdrasil Gatekeeper
scripts.text: If you have the dungeon generated already, you can enter it.
I want to go in.
I want to leave.

scripts.speaker: Yggdrasil Gatekeeper
scripts.text: The time limit to enter the dungeon has expired. You must wait for the World Tree to stabilize its power before trying to re-enter.

scripts.speaker: Yggdrasil Gatekeeper
scripts.text: The World Tree Yggdrasil has stabilized. Would you like to enter Nidhoggur's Nest again?

scripts.speaker: Yggdrasil Gatekeeper
scripts.text: If you would like to enter again, please register with me.
A great stone gate stands before you. The sculpture of a terrible dragon spreads its powerful looking wings.
Near the bottom of the gate, Laphine tribeswomen have been turned to stone and now look like they are part of the great door.
Move closer to look more carefully.
Step back.
A mysterious power prevents you from getting too close. It looks like there is something strong beyond the door...
Perhaps there's a great hidden secret beyond the gate, beyond expectation.

scripts.speaker: Yggdrasil Gatekeeper
scripts.text: An unknown error has occurred.

scripts.speaker: Yggdrasil Gatekeeper
scripts.text: You didn't ask to be admitted... You should accept admission first before entering.

scripts.speaker: Yggdrasil Gatekeeper
scripts.text: Where are the other servants, so you can work together? Each servant cannot be admitted here individually...

scripts.speaker: Historian Magniffer
scripts.text: Sure, the mainland also has lots of interesting adventures... Hello, I am Magnifier, a historian dispatched from the Prontera royal court.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magniffer
scripts.text: Does Commander Agip want to talk to me? Let's listen to his story.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magniffer
scripts.text: Why are you standing there? Go to my assistant in the Prontera Library!

scripts.speaker: Historian Magniffer
scripts.text: You've come back... Good, how's Naomi? Actually, I don't need to worry about her. She is always cheerful. Haha.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magniffer
scripts.text: Okay, let's try to contact them first, to be clear about any caves or treasures.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magniffer
scripts.text: Ah, you've come at a proper time. I found a curious thing while looking for reports from Arunafeltz.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magniffer
scripts.text: Report to Commander Hibba Agip about what we have discovered, since time is dependent on his decision.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magniffer
scripts.text: So that's how it is... we were right about some parts of it... it's called the Guardian's Nest.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magniffer
scripts.text: Finding another line of work might make for a really worthy job, but only a historian gets to know the world over..

scripts.speaker: Historian Magniffer
scripts.text: How this world is organized... and the way of the future! With our studies of the past and present we can predict what is to come.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magniffer
scripts.text: We are expecting a lot from you, expert adventurer. So, if you find anything... just tell me.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magniffer
scripts.text: Did you find the cave that the fairy tribes treat as a holy place? You are a really tough cookie. What did you find?

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: Wait a second... I have a brilliant idea.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: Let's see... This book... No... this one...? Hmm... Maybe this...

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: Oh, here it is! World Tree Yggdrasil and God's tribes... This is their book!

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: Maybe you found the central line to enter into the World Tree Yggdrasil!

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: If that's true, you've found the greatest discovery since the harnessing of mana. Isn't this exciting?

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: But we need a lot more information... Are they refusing you admission?

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: I will send a message to my assistant who is in the Prontera Library. So, help her find more information.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: I will definitely help you find a way to enter the World Tree directly so, just believe in me! Okay~!!

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: You look like you have a lot on your mind... Your face is full of curiosity and questions.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: So, did you read the whole story that I have prepared?
Not yet.
I read all the stories.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: Sheesh~ I prepared these stories for you carefully, but you didn't bother to check anything out did you?

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: It would be better if you returned after reading all of them. That's very basic data of what we should do for the future.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: Hm, good job. Maybe I don't need to check anything else, right?

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: I sent you to figure out which basic materials will be needed for the jobs ahead of us. You should bring research reports...

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: You might complain about why I didn't bring any myself... That's because I trust your abilities, don't ever take anything for granted.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: But a while ago, while you were tranferring reports from Commander Agip to the mainland, you lost those reports... remember?

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: So far, nothing's come up... Was it that somebody attacked you?

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: Somehow, the truth will come out, but we should be careful of shocking the natives if we go there unannounced and they're not prepared for our arrival.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: I've talked too much... Anyway, as you know through my report, you've found a great thing!

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: Firstly, we should find out more about the place. I expect we can, but... we can't do much without help from others.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: I have heard about recent expeditions of adventurers that have tried to contact the tribes... Have you heard anything about this?

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: Anyway, let's try to contact them first, to be clear about any caves or treasures.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: For now, you try to contact the Sapha and Laphine tribes, and try to extract information from them.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: I'll also keep searching here. If you find anything, come back and let me know.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: For now, you try to contact the Sapha and Laphine tribes, and try to extract more information.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: I'll also keep searching here. If you find anything, come back and let me know.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: Right now, we are standing on part of one of the roots of the World Tree Yggdrasil.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: This spot is connected to World Tree by the root. I think we can expect confrontations between the Sapha and Laphine here eventually, don't you think?

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: As I expected, the cave is the entrance to go to one of Yggdrasil's roots...

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: Did you find anything about the Sapha and Laphine?

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: Both sides act ambiguously, so... I'm getting worried...

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: The two tribes have some trouble amongst their top leaders. It's not anything official, but...

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: Let's report to Commander Agip about the situation so far. Then, we wait on his decision.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: We have gained a large amount of knowledge today, but...

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: What we have figured out... how is it going to influence mankind? It's so unpredictable...

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: This is only the beginning...we will be quite busy from now on.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: First, report to Commander Agip, then act according to the situation. Let me organize my research findings...

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: Finding another line of work might make for a really worthy job, but only a historian gets to know the world over..

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: How this world is organized... and the way of the future! With our studies of the past and present we can predict what is to come.

scripts.speaker: Historian Magnifier
scripts.text: We are expecting a lot from you, expert adventurer. So, if you find anything... just tell me.

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: The doctor never ever tries to come back, and there're too many things to do... How can I do it all...

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: Browse around, to take a look at the books.

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: Hey, you. Please move these books. Put them into shelf 3 row B.

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: Don't you see I am too busy? Don't hesitate. Just do it.
Look busy, and take a step back.
Help her just this once.

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: Gosh! Where is-? Where did-? Ugh! It's so difficult!

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: Ah... if you're done moving those, then these should go in shelf 3 row B.
Ah...I...see...

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: Now, I am almost done... Who are you? Are you a new assistant to Dr. Magnifier?
He asked me to bring some reports. Didn't he say anything?

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: Hmm... I haven't seen him in over a year! What's he doing now?
He said that he would send a message to you... didn't you get it?

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: Message? ...Let's see... I never expected him to write a message...

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: I will check the mailbox, wait a minute. If you get bored read those books.
It's too messy due to lots of stacked books and files. Dr. Magnifier looks like he has a ton of reports.
'Birth of the World', 'The Fiction of Odin's Myth', 'God's Battle Then After', 'Dreams of the Tribes'. There are a variety of books...

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: Oh, sorry I took so long. There was too much mail, so it took me a while to find stuff.

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: He has sent me mail over 20 times. I did not know that...

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: Ah, here's the message about you. He's said to share the information on research and reports.
What is the Doctor's area of expertise?

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: Ever since 5 years ago, he has been curious about how the world started, and so he began his search for the God of creation.

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: He researches combat between Odin and the Gods, and about the Gods' origins and life.
So, did he already know that the Rebirth of Satan Morocc has occurred before?

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: I can't be sure, but he thought someday it would occur. It broke out earlier than he expected though.
But Rune-Midgarts approved this research?

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: Our academics are not a religion. And they too have curiosity about this world's history.

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: The combat of Odin vs. the Gods, and the God's sons and their purpose... The Doctor has researched this his whole life.
But those reports haven't come out yet. Have they?

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: That's why he sent you here. By the way, this isn't the first time I've heard this.

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: After the establishment of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom and Arunafeltz, the rumors have spread in secret about their tribes, myths, etc.

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: Anyway, I should make sure that you read all these books, and I'll just keep doing my work.
Shouldn't I have filed the books?

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: The Doctor said he will pick up the books through another person. Besides, don't you need the basic information on what to do?

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: Before you go back to the Doctor, you had better read these books. So, I will go back to work.
Discovery of Heterogeneity
Report of Indigenous Tribes
Satan Morocc has known that he didn't resurrect normally or by himself.
Continuously, adventurers from Rune-Midgarts have attacked him and he is slowly losing his power. He would need more time to resurrect completely.
Satan Morocc stopped to destroy the city of Morocc, turning it into a ruined desert, then started to rip the world apart.
Satan Morocc was worried about those who would give chase, so he created Morocc clones to keep watch behind him.
Modeled after Morocc, their appearance made it difficult to go around the time-space gap.
Still the adventurers gave chase. They came from all over the world, trying to approach the Dimensional Gorge.
The reports of these adventurers have been sent to representatives of all kingdoms, and an expedition team has been created to find out more information.
The scientists of Schwarzwald created a combination metal, using fragments of metals found in the dimensional gorge.
The Schwarzwald Republic requested approval to find the source of the new metal, and since Rune-Midgarts couldn't complete the test themselves, they finally accepted.
They associated together to gather volunteers. The Assassin Guild was the first to volunteer.
The Assassins have a terrible past with Satan Morocc, so they gathered 18 members to chase him down.
About 3 hours later, all 18 members returned without any problem, and each man and woman shared the information that they had collected.
They had discovered another world with a definitively different nature and environment. And indeed, people could also live there.
The most surprising thing is the flow of time. The 18 assassins had stayed for about 2 weeks in there, yet they returned within 3 hours after departing.
The last thing to be tested... was to send adventurers who volunteered to explore the new world.
There was a flood of adventurer applications. Lots of volunteers disappeared over the dimensional gorge, and they brought back new data.
The new world could support 3 completely different eco-systems dependant upon the race of people that lived there.
The heterogenous phenomenon needed to be studied thoroughly and carefully in order to under the relationship between thair world and ours.
Just when it was expected to be impossible to travel into a different world, the first page of a new chapter was opened.
Long ago, there wasn't a sun, moon, or stars; just empty earth... and Ymir was born. Then, by making sons, Ymir grew.
But, his sons grew as well and he was killed by Odin, Vili, and Ve; 3 brothers, Gods, that attacked from different sides.
At that time of Ymir's fall his blood flooded the world... killing all in it's path.
Only Hvergelmir of the Sapha tribe escaped from this flooding of blood. And he swore vengeance in Jotunheim, which is covered with foggy snow.
Currently, one of the Sapha tribe has been discovered from beyond the Dimensional Gorge.
Other than the Sapha tribe, there was another tribe beyond the time-space gap, known as the Laphine.
The Laphine tribes gathered as well for an expedition to explore the time-space gap and figure out the World Tree's strange symptoms and perharps a cure method.
The Laphine tribe was charged with the management of Yggdrasil, to establish their lands close to Asgard, and to protect the balance of Yggdrasil's magic power.
The Laphine tribe has never contacted anyone outside of Asgard. But since they found that Yggdrasil's power if weakening...
They have declared they will attend to the high courts for the first time in 1000 human years, since the end of the battles of Gods vs. Magicians.

scripts.speaker: Assistant Naomi
scripts.text: Don't you see that I'm too busy? Don't dawdle, just go!

scripts.speaker: Grumbling Soldier
scripts.text: Nowadays, the world has turned unstable. I can't even fly comfortably anymore.

scripts.speaker: Grumbling Soldier
scripts.text: SeLarsmar Di marThusVil U SeMushVohl
What's with the cave up north?
Who are the Sapha tribesmen?
Hmm. We can talk later.

scripts.speaker: Grumbling Soldier
scripts.text: What? If you wander around there... you might return with injuries.

scripts.speaker: Grumbling Soldier
scripts.text: I don't know exactly how to explain it, but it's like it has a bad mood. There are lots of terrible monsters there.

scripts.speaker: Grumbling Soldier
scripts.text: They whisper to each other, so... something is there... But I don't care...

scripts.speaker: Grumbling Soldier
scripts.text: Might be... those Sapha tribesmen have dug in the cave before... They do have a special talent for digging.

scripts.speaker: Grumbling Soldier
scripts.text: Oh! It is because of them that we have been living here, a lowdown and dirty city, for over one hundred years.

scripts.speaker: Grumbling Soldier
scripts.text: They don't care if there's trouble with the Yggdrasil.

scripts.speaker: Grumbling Soldier
scripts.text: They are surely full of bad ideas, so... they have destroyed the Yggdrasil's root.

scripts.speaker: Grumbling Soldier
scripts.text: We are here to make sure that the Sapha don't make things worse.

scripts.speaker: Grumbling Soldier
scripts.text: Nowadays, the world has turned unstable. I can't even fly comfortably anymore.

scripts.speaker: Grumbling Soldier
scripts.text: What can you expect when Manuk giants start to dig into the world to destroy the Yggdrasil...

scripts.speaker: Grumbling Soldier
scripts.text: And the worst thing is... that strange things are strutting along the streets of the towns...

scripts.speaker: Grumbling Soldier
scripts.text: Yes, you... What do you think about the way the government is handling this...?

scripts.speaker: Grumbling Soldier
scripts.text: Although they ignore your track record, still, one should be careful...

scripts.speaker: Sighing Soldier
scripts.text: When will we be finished with this combat with the Sapha? Ugghhhh...

scripts.speaker: Sighing Soldier
scripts.text: VohlLarsmar Ha DielCyatas
What's with the cave up north?
Who are the Sapha tribesmen?
Hmm. We can talk later.

scripts.speaker: Sighing Soldier
scripts.text: Well... I'm not sure, but we have avoided going to that area.

scripts.speaker: Sighing Soldier
scripts.text: Sometimes, the dispatched researchers hang around here... I feel bad that there's nothing to see... without any reason...

scripts.speaker: Sighing Soldier
scripts.text: But the command officers make sure that there's something hidden in there.

scripts.speaker: Sighing Soldier
scripts.text: We don't know if the monsters there are strong, so we never checked it out. But on a personal level, nobody wants to go there...

scripts.speaker: Sighing Soldier
scripts.text: I don't know what others think about it... but we've had some trouble with our attitude against the Sapha tribes.

scripts.speaker: Sighing Soldier
scripts.text: We didn't try to solve the problems with talk. We attacked them first.

scripts.speaker: Sighing Soldier
scripts.text: Maybe... our command officers don't want to accept other species different than us...

scripts.speaker: Sighing Soldier
scripts.text: Don't misunderstand... Recently, we have talked about your particular species and our commanders feel grateful to you.

scripts.speaker: Sighing Soldier
scripts.text: Anyway... I'm just exhausted during this useless and nerve-wracking situation... Sigh.

scripts.speaker: Sighing Soldier
scripts.text: When will we be finished with this combat with the Sapha? Ugghhhh...

scripts.speaker: Sighing Soldier
scripts.text: Frankly, I don't think of you or any Sapha is our enemy. Sigh...

scripts.speaker: Sighing Soldier
scripts.text: Is there no way to resolve this by communicating? There's no meaning in useless combat! Geez.

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: Are you...? Are you the one collecting information from my soldiers...?

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: If you can't follow this rule, I will stop associating with you and ban all of your people from here.

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: Why have you come back, outsider?

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: Outsider. Arioss here will explain the situation with the giants, talk with him...

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: Welcome to the Laphine camp in Splendide, outsider... I am Lebiordirr. I am in charge here.

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: I was waiting for you. You came back safe, that's good news. Did you find anything?

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: Strange one, thank you for your cooperation in such situations... Please forget what has happened today...

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: ThusDurnah Ra SharVeldIyaz U UorAmanDur Yee neaOsaAdor Yee...

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: You should be cautious. Our tribe has respected the existence of you humans but...

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: I've taken a great risk in allowing you in here. So be wary.

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: Don't attract too much attention because that would make your people look bad.

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: Now, we don't need to talk much about this, so just go back where you came from.

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: Unless you have any messages for me...? Your face says you do...
No. Nothing. We can talk later.
I intend to stay. For good reasons.

scripts.speaker: Splendide Guard
scripts.text: Sir, I can drag this pest out right now.

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: No. Let's hear an explanation. Good? Now, if you want...

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: I have known that, recently, time has broken... so, you're here exploring for a solution, no?

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: Our tribe has respected you, so just forget about the searching and exploring around here.

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: I heard that you are to search for any treasure in the closed cave to the north.

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: That place is banned by order of the Laphine tribe. So, people can't just go there without permission.

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: If you can't follow this rule, I will stop associating with you and ban all of your people from here.

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: We still have an unstable relationship with the Sapha, we usually don't worry about outsiders.

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: Now, if you understand this, inform your friends.

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: We still have an unstable relationship with the Sapha, we usually don't worry about outsiders.

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: Now, if you understand this, inform your friends.
To ask the Laphines about exploring...

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: Exploring what? Choose your words wisely?

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: Do we not understand each other? What do you want?
I must explore the cave.

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: That means... that you are ignoring my warning? Is this your decision or are you just following orders?
I'm just following orders

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: Are you trying to insult me on purpose, outsider?

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: Why do you want to explore? It better be a very good reason.
It's about Dr. Magnifier's report...

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: So... What do I care about an outsider's report?

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: To protect the Yggdrasil! That's the Laphine's fate. Can you say that about yourself?

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: Do you have any proof of your birth with Odin and Yggdrasil's blessings?

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: I shouldn't say anymore. Please don't take this as being rude but, please go now!
Then I'll ask the Sapha for help.

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: What are you talking about, outsider?

scripts.speaker: Splendide Guard
scripts.text: Sir, I can get rid of this rude outsider if you wish?

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: No, wait... The Sapha tribesmen know the meaning of that place? Did you ask to associate with them?

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: Ah... How tricky... Are you testing us?

scripts.speaker: Splendide Guard
scripts.text: Calm down, sir. I will throw this outsider into prison.

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: No... No, wait. Ok, I will accept it. I can accept your admission into the Holy Sekos.

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: Okay. If you are a servant of the Yggdrasil as you claim to be, I will allow you admission. But I am not responsible for your actions.

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: And make sure that if you find anything out of the ordinary in there, that you share it with us!
But of course!

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: So... since I have agreed to allow your exploration... Arioss, help them, and take the results.

scripts.speaker: Aide Arioss
scripts.text: Sir... are you sure? This is an invasion of the Holy Sekos...

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: Invasion is a harsh word. I am allowing them entrance. Better them than a dirty giant. It might just save our lives...

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: Here, outsider. Arioss will explain the situation with the giants. Talk with him...

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: Be cautious of your actions. We already have lots of problems with the Sapha tribe as it is.

scripts.speaker: Commander Lebiordirr
scripts.text: If you are cautious with your actions, I won't place any harm on you. Fare well.
Explain about the guardian Nidhoggur's leave.

scripts.speaker: World Tree Yggdrasil

scripts.speaker: World Tree Yggdrasil

scripts.speaker: World Tree Yggdrasil

scripts.text: The path to the Guardian's Nest is just past the waterfall by the large World Tree Yggdrasil to the North. The defensive mechanisms of the Sanctuary will start immediately.

scripts.speaker: World Tree Yggdrasil
scripts.text: Use your powers... and destroy the vile Shadow...

scripts.speaker: World Tree Yggdrasil
scripts.text: This is... all I can do for you...

scripts.speaker: World Tree Yggdrasil
scripts.text: Those who want to taint the sacred Sanctuary of the Guardian... Get out.
What's a woman from the Laphine Tribe doing here...
What's happening? Let's go check it out.
From below the gorgeous stones, a strange breeze is forming.
The strange power slowly surrounds your body, the dimension is starting to shift.

scripts.speaker: World Tree Yggdrasil
scripts.text: Thank you. You're the saviour of humans and the Laphine Tribe.

scripts.speaker: World Tree Yggdrasil
scripts.text: You've defeated Nidhoggur's Shadow. But...It's not gone for good. Its powers are merely put to sleep.

scripts.speaker: World Tree Yggdrasil
scripts.text: But you have won us plenty of time. This is great.

scripts.speaker: World Tree Yggdrasil
scripts.text: Please go and report this to those in charge of Splendide and Manuk.

scripts.speaker: World Tree Yggdrasil
scripts.text: As you have seen, neither the Sapha tribe nor the Laphine tribe is at fault for the weakening of the World Tree. It's all because of the Guardian's Shadow...

scripts.speaker: World Tree Yggdrasil
scripts.text: The Guardian's insanity...is caused by powers unknown to us... You must tell this to everyone.

scripts.speaker: World Tree Yggdrasil
scripts.text: Now... Allow me to escort you out of the cursed nest.
Please let me out.
I want to look around for a while.

scripts.speaker: World Tree Yggdrasil
scripts.text: Is that so... I'll be around if you want to leave.
